sentences.en: How many children do your parents have?
sentences.canto: 你父母有幾個仔女啊？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 fu6 mou5 jau5 gei2 go3 zai2 neoi5 aa3?
sentences.mando: 你父母有几个孩子？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ fù mǔ yǒu jǐ gè hái zi?

sentences.en: They have two children; I have one older brother.
sentences.canto: 佢哋有兩個仔女，我有一個哥哥。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jau5 loeng5 go3 zai2 neoi5, ngo5 jau5 jat1 go3 go1 go1.
sentences.mando: 他们有两个孩子，我有一个哥哥。
sentences.pinyin: tā men yǒu liǎng gè hái zi, wǒ yǒu yí gè gē ge.

sentences.en: How old is your brother?
sentences.canto: 你哥哥幾歲啊？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 go1 go1 gei2 seoi3 aa3?
sentences.mando: 你哥哥几岁了？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ gē ge jǐ suì le?

sentences.en: He is thirty years old.
sentences.canto: 佢三十歲。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 saam1 sap6 seoi3.
sentences.mando: 他三十岁了。
sentences.pinyin: tā sān shí suì le.

sentences.en: Is your brother married?
sentences.canto: 你哥哥結咗婚未呀？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 go1 go1 git3 zo2 fan1 mei6 aa3?
sentences.mando: 你哥哥结婚了吗？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ gē ge jié hūn le ma?

sentences.en: Yes, he is married and has a son.
sentences.canto: 結咗婚啦，佢有一個仔。
sentences.jyutping: git3 zo2 fan1 laa3, keoi5 jau5 jat1 go3 zai2.
sentences.mando: 结婚了，他有一个儿子。
sentences.pinyin: jié hūn le, tā yǒu yí gè ér zi.

sentences.en: Are your grandparents still around?
sentences.canto: 你爺爺嫲嫲仲喺唔喺度啊？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 je4 je4 maa4 maa4 zung6 hai2 m4 hai2 dou6 aa3?
sentences.mando: 你爷爷奶奶还在吗？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yé ye nǎi nai hái zài ma?

sentences.en: My grandfather passed away a long time ago.
sentences.canto: 我爺爺過咗身好耐啦，
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 je4 je4 gwo3 zo2 san1 hou2 noi6 laa1,
sentences.mando: 我爷爷去世很久了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yé ye qù shì hěn jiǔ le.

sentences.en: My grandmother is still here.
sentences.canto: 我嫲嫲仲喺度。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 maa4 maa4 zung6 hai2 dou6.
sentences.mando: 我奶奶还在。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ nǎi nai hái zài.

sentences.en: How old is your grandmother now?
sentences.canto: 你嫲嫲而家幾多歲啊？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 maa4 maa4 ji4 gaa1 gei2 do1 seoi3 aa3?
sentences.mando: 你奶奶现在多大？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ nǎi nai xiàn zài duō dà?

sentences.en: She is in her seventies, but she's doing well.
sentences.canto: 佢七十幾歲啦，不過身體仲不錯。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 cat1 sap6 gei2 seoi3 laa3, bat1 gwo3 san1 tai2 zung6 bat1 co3.
sentences.mando: 她七十多了，不过身体还不错。
sentences.pinyin: tā qī shí duō le, bú guò shēn tǐ hái bú cuò.

sentences.en: I heard you're still in university, what are you studying?
sentences.canto: 聽講你仲讀緊大學，你讀緊咩專業啊？
sentences.jyutping: ting1 gong2 nei5 zung6 duk6 gan2 daai6 hok6, nei5 duk6 gan2 me1 zyun1 jip6 aa3?
sentences.mando: 听说你还在读大学，你在读什么专业？
sentences.pinyin: tīng shuō nǐ hái zài dú dà xué, nǐ zài dú shén me zhuān yè?

sentences.en: I'm studying computer science.
sentences.canto: 我讀緊電腦科學。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 duk6 gan2 din6 nou5 fo1 hok6.
sentences.mando: 我在读电脑科学。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài dú diàn nǎo kē xué.

sentences.en: Oh, computer science!
sentences.canto: 哦，電腦科學！
sentences.jyutping: o2, din6 nou5 fo1 hok6!
sentences.mando: 哦，电脑科学！
sentences.pinyin: ó, diàn nǎo kē xué!

sentences.en: That sounds really difficult.
sentences.canto: 聽落好難喔。
sentences.jyutping: ting1 lok6 hou2 naan4 ak1.
sentences.mando: 听起来很难哦。
sentences.pinyin: tīng qǐ lái hěn nán ó.

sentences.en: Yes, it can be quite hard sometimes, but it's also very interesting.
sentences.canto: 係啊，有時幾難㗎，不過都好有趣。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, jau5 si4 gei2 naan4 gaa3, bat1 gwo3 dou1 hou2 jau5 ceoi3.
sentences.mando: 是啊，有时候挺难的，不过也很有趣。
sentences.pinyin: shì a, yǒu shí hòu tǐng nán de, bú guò yě hěn yǒu qù.

sentences.en: So, what year are you in now?
sentences.canto: 咁你而家讀幾年級啦？
sentences.jyutping: gam3 nei5 ji4 gaa1 duk6 gei2 nin4 kap1 laa1?
sentences.mando: 那你现在读几年级了？
sentences.pinyin: nà nǐ xiàn zài dú jǐ nián jí le?

sentences.en: I'm in my third year.
sentences.canto: 我而家讀緊大三。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 duk6 gan2 daai6 saam1.
sentences.mando: 我现在在读大三。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiàn zài zài dú dà sān.

sentences.en: Third year, you're almost graduating!
sentences.canto: 大三啊，就快畢業啦！
sentences.jyutping: daai6 saam1 aa3, zau6 faai3 bat1 jip6 laa1!
sentences.mando: 大三啊，快毕业了！
sentences.pinyin: dà sān a, kuài bì yè le!

sentences.en: Yes, I have one more year until I graduate.
sentences.canto: 係啊，我仲有一年就畢業啦。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, ngo5 zung6 jau5 jat1 nin4 zau6 bat1 jip6 laa1.
sentences.mando: 是的，我还有一年就毕业了。
sentences.pinyin: shì de, wǒ hái yǒu yī nián jiù bì yè le.

sentences.en: What do you want to do after you graduate?
sentences.canto: 咁你畢業之後想做乜嘢啊？
sentences.jyutping: gam3 nei5 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 soeng2 zou6 mat1 je5 aa3?
sentences.mando: 那你毕业之后想做什么呢？
sentences.pinyin: nà nǐ bì yè zhī hòu xiǎng zuò shén me ne?

sentences.en: I want to work in software development or data analysis.
sentences.canto: 我想做軟件開發或者數據分析咁嘅工作。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zou6 jyun5 gin6 hoi1 faat3 waak6 ze2 sou3 geoi3 fan1 sik1 gam3 ge3 gung1 zok3.
sentences.mando: 我想做软件开发或数据分析这样的工作。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zuò ruǎn jiàn kāi fā huò shù jù fēn xī zhè yàng de gōng zuò.

sentences.en: That sounds really good.
sentences.canto: 聽落幾唔錯喔。
sentences.jyutping: ting1 lok6 gei2 m4 co3 ak1.
sentences.mando: 听起来挺不错的。
sentences.pinyin: tīng qǐ lái tǐng bú cuò de.

sentences.en: Hello, welcome. How many people?
sentences.canto: 您好，歡迎光臨，請問幾位？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 hou2, fun1 jing4 gwong1 lam4, cing2 man6 gei2 wai6?
sentences.mando: 您好，欢迎光临。请问几位？
sentences.pinyin: nín hǎo, huān yíng guāng lín. qǐng wèn jǐ wèi?

sentences.en: Two people, thank you.
sentences.canto: 兩位，唔該。
sentences.jyutping: loeng5 wai6, m4 goi1.
sentences.mando: 两位，谢谢。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng wèi, xiè xie.

sentences.en: Do you have a reservation?
sentences.canto: 請問有冇訂位？
sentences.jyutping: cing2 man6 jau5 mou5 ding3 wai6?
sentences.mando: 请问有订位吗？
sentences.pinyin: qǐng wèn yǒu dìng wèi ma?

sentences.en: No, we don't.
sentences.canto: 冇。
sentences.jyutping: mou5.
sentences.mando: 没有。
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu.

sentences.en: Then you might need to wait for about ten minutes, is that okay?
sentences.canto: 咁可能需要您等十幾分鐘，可唔可以？
sentences.jyutping: gam2 ho2 nang4 seoi1 jiu1 nei5 dang2 sap6 gei2 fan1 zung1, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5?
sentences.mando: 那可能需要您等十几分钟，可以吗？
sentences.pinyin: nà kě néng xū yào nín děng shí jǐ fēn zhōng, kě yǐ ma?

sentences.en: No problem.
sentences.canto: 冇問題。
sentences.jyutping: mou5 man6 tai4.
sentences.mando: 没问题。
sentences.pinyin: méi wèn tí.

sentences.en: Sorry to keep you waiting.
sentences.canto: 唔好意思，令您哋等咗好耐。
sentences.jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si3, ling6 nei5 dei6 dang2 zo2 hou2 noi6.
sentences.mando: 不好意思，让您们久等了。
sentences.pinyin: bù hǎo yì si, ràng nín men jiǔ děng le.

sentences.en: This way please. Here is our menu.
sentences.canto: 呢邊請。呢度係我哋嘅餐牌。
sentences.jyutping: ne1 bin6 cing2. ne1 dou6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 caan1 paai2.
sentences.mando: 这边请。这是我们的菜单。
sentences.pinyin: zhè biān qǐng. zhè shì wǒ men de cài dān.

sentences.en: Do you have any recommendations?
sentences.canto: 請問有咩推薦？
sentences.jyutping: cing2 man6 jau5 me1 teoi1 zin3?
sentences.mando: 请问有什么推荐？
sentences.pinyin: qǐng wèn yǒu shén me tuī jiàn?

sentences.en: Zhajiangmian is our signature dish.
sentences.canto: 炸醬麵係我哋嘅招牌菜。
sentences.jyutping: zaa3 zoeng3 min6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 ziu1 paai4 coi3.
sentences.mando: 炸酱面是我们的招牌菜。
sentences.pinyin: zhá jiàng miàn shì wǒ men de zhāo pái cài.

sentences.en: You can try it. It tastes quite good.
sentences.canto: 您哋可以試吓，味道唔錯。
sentences.jyutping: nei5 dei6 ho2 ji5 si3 haa5, mei6 dou6 m4 co3.
sentences.mando: 你们可以尝试一下，味道不错。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ men kě yǐ cháng shì yī xià, wèi dào bú cuò.

sentences.en: Does this Zhajiangmian contain peanuts? I am allergic to peanuts.
sentences.canto: 請問呢碟炸醬麵有冇花生？我對花生敏感。
sentences.jyutping: cing2 man6 ne1 dip6 zaa3 zoeng3 min6 jau5 mou5 faa1 sang1? ngo5 deoi3 faa1 sang1 man5 gam2.
sentences.mando: 请问这道炸酱面有花生吗？我对花生过敏。
sentences.pinyin: qǐng wèn zhè dào zhá jiàng miàn yǒu huā shēng ma? wǒ duì huā shēng guò mǐn.

sentences.en: Understood, we can make it without peanuts.
sentences.canto: 明白，我哋可以唔落花生。
sentences.jyutping: ming4 baak6, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 m4 lok6 faa1 sang1.
sentences.mando: 明白，我们可以不加花生。
sentences.pinyin: míng bái, wǒ men kě yǐ bù jiā huā shēng.

sentences.en: Would you like to order anything else?
sentences.canto: 仲要唔要嗌其他嘢食？
sentences.jyutping: zung6 jiu1 m4 jiu1 aai3 kei5 taa1 je5 sik6?
sentences.mando: 还要点其他菜吗？
sentences.pinyin: hái yào diǎn qí tā cài ma?

sentences.en: My friend is a vegetarian; do you have any suitable dishes for him?
sentences.canto: 我朋友係食齋嘅，有冇啱佢嘅餸？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 pang4 jau5 hai6 sik6 zaai1 ge3, jau5 mou5 ngaam1 keoi5 ge3 sung3?
sentences.mando: 我朋友是吃素的，有没有适合他的菜？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ péng yǒu shì chī sù de, yǒu méi yǒu shì hé tā de cài?

sentences.en: Of course. We have stir-fried seasonal vegetables, Mapo tofu, stir-fried broccoli, and so on.
sentences.canto: 梗係有。我哋有炒時蔬、麻婆豆腐、清炒西蘭花等等。
sentences.jyutping: gang2 hai6 jau5. ngo5 dei6 jau5 caau2 si4 so1, maa4 po4 dau6 fu6, cing1 caau2 sai1 laan1 faa1 dang2 dang2.
sentences.mando: 当然有。我们有炒时蔬、麻婆豆腐、清炒西兰花等等。
sentences.pinyin: dāng rán yǒu. wǒ men yǒu chǎo shí shū, má pó dòu fu, qīng chǎo xī lán huā děng děng.

sentences.en: One serving of stir-fried broccoli.
sentences.canto: 要一份清炒西蘭花。
sentences.jyutping: jiu1 jat1 fan6 cing1 caau2 sai1 laan1 faa1.
sentences.mando: 来一份清炒西兰花。
sentences.pinyin: lái yī fèn qīng chǎo xī lán huā.

sentences.en: Okay, would you like any drinks?
sentences.canto: 好嘅，請問你要唔要嘢飲？
sentences.jyutping: hou2 ge3, cing2 man6 nei5 jiu1 m4 jiu1 je5 jam2?
sentences.mando: 好的，请问你要饮料吗？
sentences.pinyin: hǎo de, qǐng wèn nǐ yào yǐn liào ma?

sentences.en: Two glasses of iced water, please. Thank you.
sentences.canto: 兩杯凍水就得啦，唔該。
sentences.jyutping: loeng5 bui1 dung3 seoi2 zau6 dak1 laa1, m4 goi1.
sentences.mando: 两杯冰水就好，谢谢。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng bēi bīng shuǐ jiù hǎo, xiè xie.

words.en: Indicates a completed action (you've completely finished)

sentences.en: Waiter, I'd like to pack the leftovers; could you bring me a box?
sentences.canto: 侍應，我想打包，麻煩幫我拿個盒過嚟。
sentences.jyutping: si6 jing1, ngo5 soeng2 daa2 baau1, maa4 faan4 bong1 ngo5 naa4 go3 hap6 gwo3 lei4.
sentences.mando: 服务员，我想打包，麻烦帮我拿一个盒子过来。
sentences.pinyin: fú wù yuán, wǒ xiǎng dǎ bāo, má fán bāng wǒ ná yī gè hé zi guò lái.

sentences.en: No problem.
sentences.canto: 冇問題。
sentences.jyutping: mou5 man6 tai4.
sentences.mando: 没问题。
sentences.pinyin: méi wèn tí.

sentences.en: By the way, the bill please. Thank you.
sentences.canto: 順便埋單，唔該。
sentences.jyutping: seon6 bin6 maai4 daan1, m4 goi1.
sentences.mando: 顺便买单，谢谢。
sentences.pinyin: shùn biàn mǎi dān, xiè xie.

sentences.en: Would you like to pay by card or cash?
sentences.canto: 請問您想碌卡定係俾現金？
sentences.jyutping: cing2 man6 nei5 soeng2 luk1 kaat1 ding6 hai6 bei2 jin6 gam1?
sentences.mando: 请问您想刷卡还是现金结帐？
sentences.pinyin: qǐng wèn nín xiǎng shuā kǎ hái shì xiàn jīn jié zhàng?

sentences.en: I'll pay with a credit card.
sentences.canto: 我俾信用卡。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 seon3 jung6 kaat1.
sentences.mando: 我用信用卡支付。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yòng xìn yòng kǎ zhī fù.

sentences.en: Okay. The total is 300 yuan; please tap your card here.
sentences.canto: 好嘅。總共係三百蚊，請喺呢度拍卡。
sentences.jyutping: hou2 ge3. zung2 gung6 hai6 saam1 baak3 man1, cing2 hai2 ne1 dou6 paak3 kaat1.
sentences.mando: 好的。总共是三百元，请在这里拍卡。
sentences.pinyin: hǎo de. zǒng gòng shì sān bǎi yuán, qǐng zài zhè lǐ pāi kǎ.

sentences.en: This is your receipt; thank you for coming. Have a nice day.
sentences.canto: 呢張係您張單，歡迎下次再嚟。慢慢行。
sentences.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 hai6 nei5 zoeng1 daan1, fun1 jing4 haa6 ci3 zoi3 lei4. maan6 maan6 hang4.
sentences.mando: 这是您的发票，欢迎下次再来。请慢走。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì nín de fā piào, huān yíng xià cì zài lái. qǐng màn zǒu.

sentences.en: What is your favorite type of food?
sentences.canto: 你最中意食咩菜啊？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 me1 coi3 aa3?
sentences.mando: 你最喜欢吃什么菜？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huān chī shén me cài?

sentences.en: I really like Vietnamese food and Japanese food.
sentences.canto: 我最中意食越南菜同埋日本菜。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 jyut6 naam4 coi3 tung4 maai4 jat6 bun2 coi3.
sentences.mando: 我最喜欢吃越南菜和日本菜。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huān chī yuè nán cài hé rì běn cài.

sentences.en: Do you usually eat Chinese food?
sentences.canto: 你平時食唔食中餐啊？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 ping4 si4 sik6 m4 sik6 zung1 caan1 aa3?
sentences.mando: 你平时吃中餐吗？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ píng shí chī zhōng cān ma?

sentences.en: Sometimes I eat Chinese food, but I don't eat it every day.
sentences.canto: 有時會食中餐，但係唔會每日都食。
sentences.jyutping: jau5 si4 wui5 sik6 zung1 caan1, daan6 hai6 m4 wui5 mui5 jat6 dou1 sik6.
sentences.mando: 有时候会吃中餐，但是不会每天都吃。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shí hou huì chī zhōng cān, dàn shì bù huì měi tiān dōu chī.

sentences.en: Do you eat spicy food?
sentences.canto: 你食唔食辣啊？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 sik6 m4 sik6 laat6 aa3?
sentences.mando: 你吃辣吗？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ chī là ma?

sentences.en: I like to eat things that are a little spicy, but I can't handle things that are too spicy.
sentences.canto: 我中意食有啲辣嘅嘢，不過唔可以食太辣嘅嘢。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 jau5 di1 laat6 ge3 je5, bat1 gwo3 m4 ho2 ji5 sik6 taai3 laat6 ge3 je5.
sentences.mando: 我喜欢吃有点辣的东西，不过不可以吃太辣的东西。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān chī yǒu diǎn là de dōng xi, bú guò bù kě yǐ chī tài là de dōng xī.

sentences.en: So, what Chinese dishes do you like?
sentences.canto: 咁你中意食咩中餐啊？
sentences.jyutping: gam2 nei5 zung1 ji3 sik6 me1 zung1 caan1 aa3?
sentences.mando: 那你喜欢吃什么中餐呢？
sentences.pinyin: nà nǐ xǐ huān chī shén me zhōng cān ne?

sentences.en: I like dim sum, sweet and sour pork ribs, and Peking duck.
sentences.canto: 我中意食點心、糖醋排骨同埋烤鴨。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 dim2 sam1, tong4 cou3 paai4 gwat1 tung4 maai4 haau1 aap3.
sentences.mando: 我喜欢吃点心、糖醋排骨和烤鸭。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān chī diǎn xīn, táng cù pái gǔ hé kǎo yā.

sentences.en: Then I'll cook some for you when I have time.

sentences.en: Hello, we offer two options: you can pay by the hour or by the day.
sentences.canto: 您好，我哋有兩種租法，可以斷鐘計，都可以斷日計。
sentences.jyutping: nei5 hou2 ngo5 dei6 jau5 loeng5 cung4 zou1 faat3 ho2 ji5 dyun6 zung1 gai3 dou1 ho2 ji5 dyun6 jat6 gai3
sentences.mando: 您好，我们有两种租法，可以按小时付费，也可以按天付费。
sentences.pinyin: nín hǎo wǒ men yǒu liǎng zhǒng zū fǎ kě yǐ àn xiǎo shí fù fèi yě kě yǐ àn tiān fù fèi

sentences.en: What are the respective rental fees?

sentences.jyutping: zou1 gam1 fan1 bit6 hai6 gei1 do1
sentences.mando: 租金分别是多少？
sentences.pinyin: zū jīn fēn bié shì duō shǎo

sentences.en: Hourly rental is 20 yuan per hour, and daily rental is 100 yuan per day.

sentences.jyutping: si4 zou1 hai6 mui5 siu2 si4 20 man1 jat6 zou1 hai6 mui5 jat6 100 man1
sentences.mando: 时租是每小时20元，日租是每天100元。
sentences.pinyin: shí zū shì měi xiǎo shí 20 yuán rì zū shì měi tiān 100 yuán

sentences.en: Do I need to pay a deposit first?

sentences.jyutping: seoi1 m4 seoi1 jiu3 bei2 on3 gam1 sin1
sentences.mando: 需要先付押金吗？
sentences.pinyin: xū yào xiān fù yā jīn ma

sentences.en: Yes, you need to pay a deposit first. It will be fully refunded when you return the bike.
sentences.canto: 係嘅，需要俾按金先，還車嘅時候會全額退還。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 ge3 seoi1 jiu3 bei2 on3 gam1 sin1 waan4 ce1 ge3 si4 hau6 wui6 cyun4 ngaak6 teoi3 waan4
sentences.mando: 是的，需要先付押金。还车的时候会全额退还。
sentences.pinyin: shì de xū yào xiān fù yā jīn hái chē de shí hou huì quán é tuì huán

sentences.en: Alright, is there an anti-theft lock as well?

sentences.jyutping: hou2 ge3 jau5 mou5 fong4 dou6 so2
sentences.mando: 好的，有防盗锁吗？
sentences.pinyin: hǎo de yǒu fáng dào suǒ ma

sentences.en: Yes, we provide an anti-theft lock, so you can use it without worry.

sentences.mando: 有的，我们会提供一个防盗锁，您可以放心使用。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu de wǒ men huì tí gōng yī ge fáng dào suǒ nín kě yǐ fàng xīn shǐ yòng

sentences.en: Okay, then I'll rent for four hours, thank you!
sentences.canto: 好，噉我租四個鐘，唔該！
sentences.jyutping: hou2 gam2 ngo5 zou1 sei3 go3 zung1 m4 goi1
sentences.mando: 好，那我租四个小时，谢谢！
sentences.pinyin: hǎo nà wǒ zū sì gè xiǎo shí xiè xie
